name: platformer_controller
title: Side-on platformer character controller
summary: The 2D template's CharacterBody2D: run, jump with coyote time and a jump buffer, a fall multiplier, and jump/land telemetry carrying the numbers behind "floaty". Installed under its own name so it never collides with a project's player.gd.
usage: Attach scripts/platformer_controller.gd to a CharacterBody2D with a CollisionShape2D. Every feel tunable is an @export and the F1 tuning overlay edits them live; `jump` and `land` telemetry events carry air_time and peak_height.
